name: 10pines-c6-romannumbers
title: Roman Numbers
description: Convert Arabic numbers to their Roman numeral string (1 -> I, 4 -> IV, 9 -> IX, 50 -> L, 1000 -> M) with TDD, without recursion, generalising only by removing repeated code. The course's Randori kata.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C6 - Construccion de Software Seguro usando Test Driven Development

design.notes: The whole point is letting the table of value/numeral pairs emerge by removing duplicated if-branches step by step, under the constraints of no recursion and no added accidental complexity.
